proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ _ _ X A hA hA'
  have ha : (A.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hA.card_ne_zero
  have ha' : (Aᶜ.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hA'.card_ne_zero
  have h : (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_sum_compl A X]
  field_simp
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (X : Ω → ℝ) (A : Finset Ω), A.Nonempty → Aᶜ.Nonempty → (∑ ω, X ω) / Fintype.card Ω = ((A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω) * ((∑ ω ∈ A, X ω) / A.card) + ((Aᶜ.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω) * ((∑ ω ∈ Aᶜ, X ω) / Aᶜ.card)
